Ref-Explore-v6b.dc.html.title: Linked · Exploration v6b (copy, unchanged): where leaving the Training Grounds returns

Ref-Gear-Mastery-v2.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copy) with a Mastery button (opens v2b)

Mastery-v2b-FromGear.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v2b · from the gear screen, view only. New branch names; weapon passives (Backstab) sit under the base cards

Mastery-v2a-TrainingGrounds.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v2a · at the Training Grounds. New branch names (Warlord, Blademaster, Guardian, Basher); switch to Mel: Backstab is a passive under Throw, shown as Backstab+ once learned

Ref-Gear-Mastery-v3.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copy) with a Mastery button (opens v3b)

Mastery-v3b-FromGear.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v3b · from the gear screen, view only. Backstab's text no longer mentions Sneak Attack

Mastery-v3a-TrainingGrounds.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v3a · at the Training Grounds. Backstab's text no longer mentions Sneak Attack (players find the combo themselves)

Ref-Gear-Mastery-v4.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copy) with a Mastery button (opens v4b)

Mastery-v4b-FromGear.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v4b · from the gear screen, view only. The weapon's cards and passives share one wood tray

Mastery-v4a-TrainingGrounds.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v4a · at the Training Grounds. Base cards and passives (Mel's Throw + Backstab+) grouped on a wood tray like the gear screen's

Mastery-v5a-Honeycomb.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v5a · Honeycomb board: touching hexes like placed map tiles. The weapon tile sits with its cards and passives around it; branches run east as rows. Names sit inside the hexes

Mastery-v5b-Climb.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v5b · Climb from the weapon: the tray sits along the bottom with compact tiles; each branch is a column climbing to its capstone. Names sit beside the hexes

Mastery-v5c-WeaponRoot.dc.html.title: Weapon mastery v5c · Weapon as the root: one big weapon hex starts the tree, its cards and passives hang off it as badges, and the lines fan out to each branch
